result.summary: Juniper Solutions has been assigned to replace the bath taps and change the TRV, and both the contractor and the tenant have been told. The landlord, Freya Mercer, clearly approved the quote in event 023. Juniper Solutions inspected the problem and wrote the quote, so they were the obvious choice. The ticket is on hold in scheduling until they confirm an appointment date, with a follow-up in 2 days.
result.situation: The tenant at Flat 19, 159 Juniper Mews reported that the bathroom tap squirts water when the shower runs. The landlord agreed for us to instruct a contractor (event 008), and Juniper Solutions attended (event 019). They said the bath taps need replacing, recommended changing the TRV, and sent a quote. The quote went to the landlord (event 020), who approved raising an order for the works (event 023). The case was in scheduling, waiting for the order to be raised and an appointment booked.
